text:
The European Court of Human Rights held, by 9 votes to 8 in the Grand Chamber, that the UK did not violate Article 6(1), because applying state immunity under the State Immunity Act 1978 to bar Mr Al-Adsani's torture claim against Kuwait pursued a legitimate aim and was proportionate. The Court also found no violation of Article 3 or Article 13. I'm less sure of the vote split on those two articles than on Article 6.

CONFIDENCE: 80
